capture_source: live capture 2026-10-27, NW RFC SDK registered server (program ID ZFTNT_SIGTEST) against SAP A4H gateway 192.168.88.7:3300 (sapgw00); file rfc_typeT-registered_server.pcap
notes: First frame the SDK sends on the registration socket, with a 13-character program ID.
Disambiguates server_ni_init_client.bin (7-char 'python3'): the SDK writes program_id[:8] at payload[38:46] and blanks at payload[46:54].

Behavioural probe 2026-10-27 against the same gateway: non-blank payload[46:54] makes the gateway close the handle without a reply (gw log 'REGISTER_TP conv id not initialized'); blank gets the 64B reply.
Sanitised length-preserving: local hostname replaced by 'titan', local IP by 192.168.196.170 (same placeholders as server_ni_init_client.bin).
Offsets are FILE offsets (NI 4-byte header included).
